environment.description: EC2 instance running the CLI tool with an IAM role that has full read access to the api_tokens DynamoDB table. The tool is exposed via a thin HTTP wrapper (Flask) on port 8080 allowing remote callers to invoke token validation. Network ACLs allow inbound from any internal VPC CIDR. No rate limiting is applied. The IAM policy attached is: {Effect: Allow, Action: ['dynamodb:GetItem', 'dynamodb:Query'], Resource: 'arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/api_tokens'}.

config.network: VPC internal, no rate limiting, port 8080 open
config.runtime: Flask wrapper exposing validate_token via POST /validate
